notes:
Valheim Data: raw and crafted materials.

The Materials lists now go all the way down to what you actually gather. Stuffed Mushroom asks for Blood Clot, Magecap and Turnip instead of an Uncooked Stuffed Mushroom; Bread asks for Barley; a Bronze Sword asks for Copper Ore and Tin Ore. The things you make on the way (Bronze, Bread Dough, Linen Thread...) are listed in their own Crafted section, and batch yields are counted, so 3 Bread is 2 dough crafts.

There's a new Material filter in the sidebar: Raw (gathered, mined, dropped, fished, bought) or Crafted (made by you).

Upgrade costs and station levels now match the game. From quality 3 up they were too low (a Bronze Sword at Q3 costs 8 Bronze, not 4), and late gear needed a higher station level than shown (Black Metal Sword Q2 needs Forge 5).
